title: Quantum Motion from Local Transition Susceptibility
summary: We characterize quantum motion through the susceptibility of a quantum state to weak localized state conversion. The susceptibility can be related to a passage speed characterizing local motion independently of probability transport. For individual WKB branches, it reproduces the magnitude of the local dispersion velocity in both propagating and evanescent regions.
